title: the outline check reuses a hand-opened question on the same Q#n
intention: cairn outlinecheck opens no second question for an open [Q#n] when an open question on the same ticket already names that Q#n, whoever opened it.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: Q#119 on e56a68e651c2 and Q#116 on 312be610152e each stand twice in Akien's inbox, once opened by hand (cairn question open, source None) and once by cairn outlinecheck. _open_what_stands reuses only questions whose source is outline_check. Both copies hold BUILDME, and he is asked the same thing twice.
traces_to: Law 1: a question already standing at his gate is a settled ask, and asking it twice spends his attention re-deriving it.
how: In _open_what_stands, the open-[Q#n] branch reuses any open question on the ticket (Q.open_for) whose text matches re.search(rf'Q#{n}(?!\d)'). The conflict branch keeps its outline_check-only reuse. The existing duplicates stay cross-noted (cairn question note). A withdraw verb is not built here; it stays as residue in trouble question-has-no-withdraw-verb-for-a-duplicate.

clauses.claim: with a hand-opened question naming Q#7 open on the fixture ticket, a check touching 2.1.2 opens no question and lists the hand question under questions_already_open
a hand question naming Q#70 on the ticket, or naming Q#7 on another ticket, does not stop the check opening its Q#7 question
with a hand-opened question on the ticket, a conflict still opens its own question: conflict reuse reads only outline_check's questions

decisions.text: D1: _open_what_stands reuses for an open [Q#n] any open question on the ticket whose text names Q#n as a whole number; the conflict branch keeps its source filter.
D2: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause, over the World and Stub fixtures of the neighbouring proof.

out: cairn/tools/question (the withdraw verb is the trouble's residue)

measured.saw: 17 open (ticket, Q#n) pairs; 5 named by hand-opened questions, each asking its own Q#n; Q#119 on e56a68e651c2 and Q#116 on 312be610152e stand twice
measured.how: a scan of CairnCommons/questions/open-*.json at origin/main for unresolved questions, grouping re.findall(r'Q#(\d+)(?!\d)') by ticket
